name: Ponta Grossa

queries.query: Ponta Grossa official cadastral parcel map geoserver prefeitura cadastro imobiliario mapa
queries.result: Found the official municipal GeoWeb/georeferencing announcement and service guide, plus Paraná Interativo's official ArcGIS REST cartographic service with a Ponta Grossa group layer. No public municipal parcel-polygon API was verified.

queries.query: Ponta Grossa cadastro territorial mapa lotes prefeitura serviço oficial
queries.result: Official municipal pages document GeoWeb, Cadastro Técnico Municipal/geoprocessamento, lot-plant and parcel subdivision/unification procedures, and construction-viability lookup by property-registration number. Anonymous GeoWeb host access was unavailable during this attempt.

registryBasis: A municipal GeoWeb/geoprocessing system and Cadastro Técnico Municipal are directly evidenced by official Ponta Grossa pages and procedures, but no anonymous parcel-polygon endpoint or usable parcel response was established in this attempt.

source.localCustodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Ponta Grossa / Instituto de Planejamento de Ponta Grossa (IPLAN), municipal GeoWeb and Cadastro Técnico Municipal

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The municipal GeoWeb is described as a city geoprocessing/georeferencing and cadastral-information platform; Paraná Interativo publishes a Ponta Grossa cartographic group.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The Paraná Interativo group and sublayer metadata were fetched anonymously. The exposed Ponta Grossa sublayers are annotation, polyline, and raster; no parcel polygon layer was identified.
coverageAssessment.exactPointInterpretation: A point-intersects query against the accessible Ponta Grossa line layer returned zero features. This is a layer/geometry miss only, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

remainingUncertainty: The municipal GeoWeb may expose cadastral parcels behind its current authentication and web application routes, but the host timed out for anonymous HTTP access and no JavaScript/configuration or parcel API response could be inspected. The Paraná Interativo cartographic service is not a parcel source on the evidence obtained.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently inspect the current municipal GeoWeb through its public, non-authenticated map route if available and qualify any parcel layer, CRS, native identity, and citywide coverage before adapter admission.
